_meta.datasheet_section: §3 Pin Configurations (8-land WSON 6x5), §4 Pin Description, §16 Ordering, §18-4 WSON 6x5 outline
_meta.package: 8-WSON 6x5x0.8 mm, 1.27 mm pitch, exposed pad D1 3.4 x E1 4.0 mm
_meta.notes: ZN = 8-WSON 6x5, I = -40..85 C. RESET# option removed (rev 0.04): pin 7 is HOLD#/SIO3 only. VCC 2.3-3.6 V. [height] 0.8 mm max: DS §18-4 WSON 6x5 table: A max 0.80. [temp] DS Table 15 Absolute Maximum Ratings: ambient operating (Industrial) −40…85 °C; Ordering MX25V8035FZNI

pins.name: WP#/SIO2
pins.note: internal pull-up only while the pin is physically unconnected; disabled once wired, so drive or pull it if connected; [connect] DS §4 Pin Description note: internal pull-up active only while WP#/SIO2 is physically unconnected

pins.name: HOLD#/SIO3
pins.note: same pull-up rule as WP#; no RESET# function on this part; [connect] DS §4 Pin Description note: internal pull-up active only while HOLD#/SIO3 is physically unconnected

pins.name: VCC
pins.note: [connect] DS §4 Pin Description: VCC power supply

pins.name: EP
pins.note: exposed pad: leave floating or connect to the same GND as pin 4 only; no other net; avoid vias/traces under it (§18-4 note); [connect] DS §18-4 note (p78): leave EP floating or connect to the same ground as GND pin; no other net
